Name: SLAM
Overview: Slam is a fast-paced brick-breaking action arcade game fusing all of the best elements from Breakout, Tempest, and Pinball. Spin and tilt your bat around the circular 3D arena; use the magnet for total control of the ball; collect 14 types of eye-popping power-ups, and smash more than 20 innovative types of bricks through 100 levels of frantic fun.
